title: Petition of Gray Line of Boston, Inc. and New England Sightseeing Tours, Inc. requesting that the Department of Public Utilities, pursuant to G.L. c. 159A, § 7A approve a name change from Gray Line of Boston, Inc. to New England Sightseeing Tours, Inc. and transfer to New England Sightseeing Tours, Inc. a certificate of public convenience and necessity for sightseeing and a charter license.
